title: Red Hat Security Advisory: OpenShift Container Platform 4.20.46 bug fix and security update
description: Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform 4.20.46 includes critical security fixes addressing two vulnerabilities: a kernel IPv4 issue (CVE-2026-98432) involving freeing inet_opt and ireq_opt after an RCU grace period, and an out-of-bounds write in the Google Brotli decoder (CVE-2026-111497). Users of OpenShift Container Platform 4.20 are advised to upgrade to this release to mitigate these vulnerabilities.
